0022600032.text: The Lakers (7-2, on a three-game win streak and 4-1 at home) host the Portland Trail Blazers (6-1, also on a three-game streak and 5-0 on the road) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group C play. Los Angeles is missing Sandro Mamukelashvili, who is day-to-day with illness and a game-time decision, while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), all listed as out. The Lakers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 136-129 in Los Angeles on October 27, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
